name: Margin Report 2
definition: Provides the details on the margin report per margin account, and optionally per non-clearing member.

MarginProduct.name: Margin Product
MarginProduct.definition: Specifies if the margin is related to equities or fixed income.

CollateralisedMarginAccountIndicator.name: Collateralised Margin Account Indicator
CollateralisedMarginAccountIndicator.definition: Used to indicate whether the reported margin account is collateralised or not. If not collateralised, the account is configured for informational reporting.

NonClearingMember.name: Non Clearing Member
NonClearingMember.definition: Provides details about the non clearing member identification and account.

MarginCalculationSummary.name: Margin Calculation Summary
MarginCalculationSummary.definition: Provides the margin calculation summary per margin account.

MarginCalculation.name: Margin Calculation
MarginCalculation.definition: Provides the margin details such as the exposure amount and the initial margin.
